title: buildzr model export (buildzr.model/2)
description: The model the viewer is about: every element with its containment (the static model, then the deployment elements), explicit relationships only, authored views and deployment environments. Written by buildzr/site/model.py as canonical JSON (sort_keys, compact separators, UTF-8, trailing newline). Design note v4, section C. Readers MUST ignore element 'type' values they do not know.

modelHash.description: sha256 of the canonical bytes of this object with modelHash set to the empty string.

elements.description: Pre-order depth-first over the containment tree (every parent before its children). Roots in model order: people first, then software systems; children in model order. Then the deployment elements, pre-order, in Structurizr's order (deployment nodes; a node's children: child nodes, infrastructure nodes, software system instances, container instances).

relationships.description: Explicit relationships only: none that buildzr implied (Structurizr linkedRelationshipId), so no instance relationship copied from a container relationship. Sorted by id.

environments.description: Deployment environments in model order: those of the deployment nodes, then those only named by a deployment view.

path.description: Slug path: parent path + '/' + slug(name). slug = lower-case, runs of characters outside [a-z0-9] become '-', trimmed of '-'; empty -> 'element'. On collision among siblings (or among roots) the 2nd, 3rd ... in model order get '-2', '-3' ... The root slug 'deploy' is reserved: deployment elements are 'deploy/<environment key>/<node>/...' (an instance takes the name of the element it is an instance of), and a static root that would be 'deploy' is 'deploy-2'.

modelId.description: Structurizr numeric id as exported today (not stable across edits).

type.description: Person, SoftwareSystem, Container, Component, Element (custom elements, never drawn), DeploymentNode, InfrastructureNode, ContainerInstance, SoftwareSystemInstance. Readers ignore unknown types.

parent.description: null for roots, including top-level deployment nodes.

tags.description: As in the Structurizr JSON (insertion order, defaults first). Never re-sorted.

group.description: Group name, nested groups joined by '/' as Structurizr writes them.

views.description: Keys of the authored views this element appears in, in workspace view order.

instanceOf.description: Instances only: the Container (ContainerInstance) or SoftwareSystem (SoftwareSystemInstance) this is an instance of. name, description and technology are that element's.

environment.description: Deployment elements only: the key of their environment.

instances.description: Deployment nodes only: the number of instances, a number ('3') or a range ('0..N').

healthChecks.description: Instances only, when the Structurizr JSON has health checks.

id.description: '<source path>-><destination path>'; when a pair has several relationships, every one of them gets ':<slug(description)>' (empty description -> 'rel'), with '-2', '-3' ... on remaining collisions in model order.

name.description: The environment name as written in the model, e.g. 'Production'.

id.description: 'deploy/<key>': the prefix of the ids of its deployment elements.

nodes.description: Ids of its top-level deployment nodes, in model order.

views.description: Keys of its deployment views, in workspace order.

scope.description: Scoped element path; null for landscape views and for deployment views of every software system.

environment.description: Deployment views only: the key of the environment they show.
